_doc: Project anchor for this design system's Figma integration. Single source of truth for which Figma file we read from, and for the identity that generation needs. Maps in maps/*.json resolve their `source` keys against this file. Never hard-code a file key in a script or a skill — read it from here, so pointing the system at a different file is one edit.

bridge._doc: Read-only, via the OFFICIAL Figma MCP connector. No daemon, no plugin, no Figma Desktop. Tools: get_metadata (structure), get_variable_defs (variables on a node), get_design_context (a node as reference code), get_screenshot. Chosen over the alternatives because everything the exploration -> report -> decide -> build arc needs is a READ, and every other bridge adds a local install and a background process to fail. Write-back is deliberately not wired — see README.md.

weave.name: weave — Mokkap masterclass
weave.purpose: The design source. A dark screen-recorder UI. Variables, text styles and component sets live here.
weave._publishedNote: Not published as a library, so component instances have no durable componentKey yet. Until it is published the only join available is pageId + componentSetId, and those are file-local and change. Record them, but treat them as refreshable — see schema/components.schema.json.

prefix._doc: Set once in /ds.config.json via `pnpm init-ds <name>`. Repeated here only so a Figma script has one file to read; ds.config.json is authoritative and init-ds rewrites both.
prefix.name: ds

variableNaming._doc: MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. These are variables observed on real nodes in the source file. Note the `-ds` INFIX: it is part of the Figma name and must NOT survive into the CSS custom property. The group separator has not been confirmed, so `separatorUnknown` is true — resolve it with a live read before generating tokens, because it decides the DTCG nesting.
knownProblems: `space-0/1/3/5` is a numeric index (0, 2, 8, 16) while `radius-m` is a t-shirt scale — two naming systems in one file. Decide which one wins before generating; do not reproduce both.
`interactive-selectedbg` is a run-on word; every other token is dash-separated.
`control-waveform` is component-specific but sits in the global namespace.

font._doc: Observed in the source file. Confirm the weights actually used before writing type tokens — the observed styles disagree with each other (see knownProblems).
knownProblems: Line height disagrees between styles: UI/Button uses 1.2487 while every other style uses 100. One of the two is wrong and it must be resolved before type tokens are generated.

themes._doc: The source file has no light/dark axis — it is dark-only. Recorded here because dark-only BY DECISION and dark-only BY OMISSION are different states, and only one of them is safe to build on.

variableCollections._doc: Figma collection -> canonical DTCG source file under packages/tokens/tokens/. EMPTY: ds-explore fills this from a live read. A Figma variable whose collection has no entry here resolves to `code: null` in maps/tokens.json and is reported as drift — that is the signal, not a silent gap.

variantConventions._doc: A Figma variant property value must match the component's prop value exactly, or the two surfaces describe different components. The canon lives in .ai/maps/prop-map.md §1 and packages/react/prop-map.config.json — THOSE ARE AUTHORITATIVE; this is a pointer, not a copy.
variantConventions.propertyCase: TitleCase property name, prop-exact value — Hierarchy=secondary, Size=m
variantConventions.statesAreNotVariants: Hover / Pressed / Focused are runtime states the browser owns. They must not become a variant property that maps to a prop. See .ai/maps/proposals/README.md.
